description:
Bill of Materials (BOM) for datex4j. Import this artifact under dependencyManagement with
    scope=import to pin every published datex4j module to a single, consistent version, then declare
    the individual datex4j dependencies you need without repeating their version. Covers every
    published artifact: the model SPI, the aggregate and per-version model modules (v2.0-v2.3 and
    v3.0-v3.7), the XML/JSON codecs, validation, builders, location, the domain modules and the OCPI
    bridge. The non-published modules (examples, integration tests) are intentionally excluded.
